messages:
alex: Quick flag - release branch build red. Sample app startup failing after typegen regen landed.

nina: doh. any stack trace?

ci-bot: pipeline 5032 failed at job 'integration/sample-app'.

ci-bot: ```
UnhandledPromiseRejectionWarning: Error: InvalidAuthConfig: unknown field 'retry_policy'
    at validate (/workspace/sdk/lib/auth/index.js:88:11)
    at startServer (/workspace/sample-app/server/start.js:23:5)
```

leo: typegen-bot reported a rename in the generated types: `auth.d.ts` changed 'retryPolicy' -> 'retry_policy' (snake_case). That's a breaking API shape change.

typegen-bot: regen diff: 1 file changed (packages/typegen/out/auth.d.ts). Notes: naming convention normalized to snake_case for backwards-incompatible field names. 

maya: whoa, snake_case? We standardize on camelCase in runtime SDKs. How did that bypass review?

alex: looks like an automated normalizer ran in the typegen pipeline. The commit was: 'chore(typegen): normalize names to snake_case' by bot-user. It landed without manual approval because it was in the 'auto' label group.

nina: sample-app pulls from npm package (v1.8.2). Repo now contains regenerated types that don't match published packages. So local tests pass when built with the old sdk but fail in CI that installs published release.

leo: immediate mitigation options: revert the normalization in typegen, or add a compatibility layer in runtime that accepts both snake_case and camelCase options. Revert is safest.

maya: revert PR would be fastest to restore parity. But we should also prevent auto-normalizers from changing public API shape without semver bump.

alex: agree. I'll open a revert and a follow-up PR to add compatibility parsing.

nina: also propose a CI gate: after typegen runs in CI, run a lightweight 'install-published-sdk-and-run-sample' job (post-regen smoke test) to detect mismatch between generated types and published runtime.

release-bot: suggestion: enforce a check that any typegen commit touching public typings must include a manual review label and bump-type label (major/minor/patch) in commit message.

leo: we have an existing ruleset for semver but it excludes auto-generated-only commits. That exclusion needs refinement: codegen-only changes can still be breaking.

alex: created PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/typegen/pull/221 revert normalization and added test that validates camelCase field names are preserved.

maya: opened ticket DEVEX-301: "typegen autopruner must not rename public fields; add semver gating and sample-app smoke test". Assigned to devex team.

ci-bot: PR 221: running CI.

nina: while revert runs, can we publish a short patch that makes runtime tolerant? e.g. accept both forms when parsing config. That will reduce customer risk if any release slip through.

alex: here's a quick patch I tested locally:

```js
// packages/sdk/src/auth/parse.js
function normalizeAuthPayload(payload) {
  if (payload.retry_policy && !payload.retryPolicy) {
    payload.retryPolicy = payload.retry_policy;
  }
  return payload;
}

module.exports = { normalizeAuthPayload };
```

nina: add test and changelog, mark as patch, publish asap. I'll coordinate the publish.

release-bot: recommend publishing patch to npm (v1.8.3) after PR merge. Also run release post-checks against sample-app.

leo: addendum: update the regen bot config to skip normalization step for fields listed in 'public_api_whitelist' file. That way we can normalize internal fields but preserve public ones.

maya: good idea. I'll add that config and a README note in typegen.

ci-bot: PR 221 checks passed. Merge complete.

alex: PR 222 created with compatibility shim, tests, and changelog entry: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/222. CI green. Requesting urgent publish.

release-bot: publishing package @redwood/sdk@1.8.3 now (patch). Post-release job will run sample-app smoke verification against published tarball.

ci-bot: post-release sample-app verification job started.

nina: thanks team. after this, let's add a small checklist to the CODEOWNERS/PR template for typegen: ensure public shape stability, semver label, and smoke test included.

maya: filed follow-ups: DEVEX-302 (regen bot config whitelist), DEVEX-303 (post-release smoke verification).

alex: lesson learned: auto changes to generated artifacts are high risk. We need stricter guardrails.

leo: noted. closing thread once post-release verification passes.
